image_budget.counting_rule: Count official images, screenshots, charts, and clumsy doodles together; do not create one image per paragraph.

tasks.purpose: 填写这张图在正文中承担的唯一判断。

preserve: 本图只画：填写一个主体关系和一个段落判断。
output_constraints: Horizontal 16:9 body illustration; one main idea only; largest possible flat color blocks
Pure white background with no texture, shadow, gradient, or decorative environment
No readable words, letters, numbers, labels, captions, or interface text inside the image
Hard pixelated mouse-drawn edges, deliberately low-resolution appearance, and mobile-readable silhouettes
avoid: Polished editorial illustration, clean vector art, smooth curves, anti-aliased linework, pencil, crayon, watercolor, paper grain, collage, realistic lighting, 3D, photorealism, cinematic composition, cute professional cartoon style, or balanced graphic design
Logos, trademarks, watermarks, readable text, garbled text, fake interfaces, real-person likenesses, or verified-looking news scenes
Unsupported causal claims or visual relations not established by the article
